chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Verily, Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, did not prescribe for women any making up (of missed prayers) or fasting other than the fasting of Ramadan, unless it is a vow or voluntary (fasting).
ai.seo_question: Do women need to make up missed prayers or fast extra days in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this ruling to highlight the divine mercy (*rahmah*) granted to women, distinguishing their obligations from men's due to physiological and social burdens. This specific exemption from *qada* for missed prayers underscores the Shia jurisprudential principle that ease is prioritized over strictness in cases of natural hardship, a view supported by the majority of Shia jurists.
